facts.text: Curved Body-Mounted Solar Panels was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
Body-mounted curved silicon solar panels generating 1,100 W, designed with integral thermal radiators to dump electronic heat into space.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Eliminated mechanical solar array drive vibration, giving Kepler the ultra-stable platform required for transit photometry.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit.
Set the engineering standard for vibration-free space astronomy architectures.
